correctness.rationale: A leaf-preserving deletion/reinsertion bijection counts every compatible prescribed parent-to-leaf marking as exactly (n-r-1)! of the (n-1)! possible recursive trees, including boundary r=n-1. Exact inclusion-exclusion yields the partial-rencontres vector law; compatible mark pairs yield the signed covariance; mixed factorial moments yield the independent Poisson limits; leaf subtraction yields label-dependent protection probabilities. The actual standalone script enumerated every recursive tree through n=8 and passed 6196 exact rational checks; finite checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The assessed result is the entire label-indexed parent-to-final-leaf cylinder probability law, exact inter-parent covariance and joint Poisson age law, with age-resolved protection as an application. Mahmoud-Ward 2015 gives root-protection and aggregate-protection formulas, which are prior and are explicitly excluded from novelty. Devroye-Janson 2013/2014 Section 7 derives a Poisson leaf-child count for a limiting random fringe root and protected proportions, but not label-specific finite joint direct-leaf-parent marks or cross-parent dependence. Mahmoud-Smythe 1991 concerns leaves of whole descendant subtrees; its complete text could not be materially inspected and remains a priority risk. Related published exact root-degree/leaves and root-attachment/path-length findings do not imply the joint leaf-parent mark law. Database searches are not proof of global novelty.
residual_risks: The complete 1991 Mahmoud-Smythe full text was unavailable; it may contain implicit marked-edge identities beyond its abstract.
Any unlocated general recursive-tree or increasing-tree enumeration could encode the joint leaf-parent cylinders.
Originality has only self-review, not independent literature-priority certification.

source_inspections.assessment: Section 7 gives a Poisson number of leaf children of the limiting fringe root at fixed Yule age, mean 1-exp(-t), together with its protected probability. This is a scalar asymptotic precursor, but it contains no finite all-birth-label marked-edge cylinder law, inter-parent covariance or joint fixed-parent Poisson vector. Aggregate limits are prior, not novelty.

value.rationale: The direct leaf children of a labeled vertex are the local obstruction to vertex protection, and their joint dependences control statistical fluctuations of localized leaf-parent structure. The theorem completely identifies their finite-dimensional binary cylinder law rather than only a marginal or mean, identifies the exact negative inter-parent covariance opposite to positive within-parent dependence, and gives a full fixed-dimensional independent-Poisson scaling profile. The age-resolved protection curve provides a natural application and recovers known aggregate formulas as an independent consistency check; it is not an arbitrary statistic slice.
